piezas.titulo: Written production: Name, country and introductions
texto: Lexical and grammar practice: complete an introduction form. Apply the two basic structures you have learned: 1) [Pronoun] + ชื่อ + [Name]. 2) [Pronoun] + เป็นคน + [Country] + [Polite particle]. Choose the polite pronoun («ผม» or «ฉัน») that suits the level of formality and your personal preference, making sure you do not insert arbitrary spaces within each word block.
